adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, `feed_key` constructs a Redis key (`"feed-modified:..."`) but nothing in the diff ever reads or writes that key, and `poll_feed` always does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` then iterates `rss.items.each` importing every item each run. Additionally, lib/topic_retriever.rb calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline during `perform_retrieve` when `feed_polling_enabled?`, which would also trigger a full-feed poll. This is a diff-grounded performance/maintainability issue (dead method + misleading implied incremental behavior), not a directly verifiable functional defect.
